skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop, operate, and maintain management information systems for economic, management, and business administration fields.
Deploy projects related to digital transformation, business restructuring, and intelligent management systems.
Effective communication, time management, and adaptability to changes.
Write reports and deliver professional presentations.
Work independently or collaboratively in a group.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of management information systems.
Develop, operate, and manage information systems in organizations and businesses.

prerequisite_courses: Accumulate 75% of the credits in the curriculum
